t: You are looking at a statue of Queen Victoria at Carlton House Terrace. The sculptor was Sir Thomas Brock, described as the undisputed leading British sculptor of his day. His most famous work is the Victoria Memorial in front of Buckingham Palace. He also redesigned her effigy on British coinage. Victoria reigned from 1837 until 1901, for 63 years and 216 days, which was longer than any earlier monarch. Her reign defined the Victorian era, and in 1876 she became Empress of India.
